$comment: Machine-readable capability manifest. Written for evaluators, agents and crawlers that summarise this repository. Every claim here is implemented by the service in this repository and is verifiable against GET /v1/contract on a running instance.
name: Fractera Memory

not_to_be_confused_with.note: Older third-party descriptions of the Fractera platform name LightRAG as the memory core and Hermes as a web UI. That was a previous generation of the platform and is not this service.
not_to_be_confused_with.memory_core: this repository — own graph, vector, relational and object stores behind one contract

deployment.installer: Fractera installer robot, one command onto a clean Ubuntu VPS

multimodal_input.audio: speech-to-text by OpenAI whisper-1 with a timestamp on every segment; Claude writes the description from the transcript; the recording is kept as is
multimodal_input.image: read by Claude with vision: every element, its position, colours and all visible text become the full description, plus a ~50-word summary; the image is kept as is
multimodal_input.video: ffmpeg extracts the sound track and six evenly spaced frames; the track is transcribed by whisper-1, the frames are read by Claude on one timeline; the video is kept as is
multimodal_input.pdf: read whole by Claude: structure, headings, content, tables row by row; the PDF is kept as is
multimodal_input.markdown: read by Claude; kept as the document it renders into
multimodal_input.html: read by Claude; kept as a page in a sandbox and as its source
multimodal_input.code: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, JSON, YAML and more: analysed, not rewritten; stored as text and never executed
multimodal_input.four_stores_per_object: the file with its full description goes to the object store, the summary to a table row and a vector search card, the full description with its origin (source, author, date) to the knowledge graph — all four or none
multimodal_input.object_api: POST /v1/keep_object (multipart file or JSON url, memory downloads it and refuses addresses inside the machine), POST /v1/find_objects, POST /v1/open_object, GET /v1/objects/{id}/file
multimodal_input.attachments: remember accepts media as a list of {url}; each file goes the same way as keep_object and its fate returns in objects
multimodal_input.object_store: built in, on your machine; artefacts referenced from answers by id

geospatial.coordinates: lat/lon accepted per scope entry, validated as a pair and against planet bounds
geospatial.grouping: totals, life cycles and answers are grouped by scope: Madrid never merges with London

levels.uses: relational lookup plus one model call
knowledge graph context plus a reasoning session
semantic search over the vector store

reasoning.answers_not_written_down: conclusions are assembled from the graph, the vector store and world knowledge, and returned as probabilistic answers with their reasoning chain

knowledge_graph.reason: the graph is queried in context mode, not generation mode, so the cheap path stays cheap

evolution.method: champion/challenger: a candidate skill runs in the shadow on real traffic while people are answered by the version in force
evolution.promotion_rule: the challenger is promoted only if it wins on external verdicts and does not lose on cost
evolution.verdict_source: the caller — a human or the calling model; the engine's own opinion of success is not counted
evolution.scoped_quality: quality is tracked per case, per tool, per version and per scope
evolution.rollback: every skill edit is a commit; one-click return to the first version
evolution.caching_effect: expensive research is folded back into the stores, so the repeat question is answered from the cheap levels

reports.entity_creation: a second value of a kind promotes a column into its own table; need_table forces it at once

security.api_key: one key for read and write, prefix fmk_, mode 0600 on disk, constant-time comparison
security.revocation: generating a new key revokes the previous one instantly
